description: Set up the target document for a data merge: insert a text field placeholder into a text frame, or make a graphic frame an image or QR code field placeholder (Data Merge panel). The document needs a data source first (data_merge with mergeRecords: false); returns every placeholder in the document

field.description: Data merge field name (a column of the data source)

frameId.description: For text: the text frame to insert into; for image and qr: the frame to use as the placeholder

kind.description: text inserts the field into text; image fills a frame with the image the record names; qr fills a frame with a QR code made from the record

offset.description: For text: the insertion point within the frame text, 0-based (default: the end of the frame text)

name: add_data_merge_placeholder
title: Add Data Merge Placeholder
